newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prudential buys NZI Life for NZ$163.3 million.
newsitem.headline: Prudential buys NZI Life for NZ$163.3 million.

text.p: Prudential said on Wednesday it had bought NZI Life from General Accident for NZ$163.3 million.
NZI Life is currently the third largest life company in New Zealand with funds under management of $1.3 billion and more than 180,000 customers.

Trevor Perry, managing director of Prudential Australia and New Zealand, said the acquisition consolidated Prudential's positon as New Zealand's number one life insurer in terms of new annual premium income.
It takes Prudential to number three in terms of funds under management.
"The addition of the NZI Life business to Prudential now gives us nearly 300,000 customers with funds under management of $2.3 billion," Perry said.
He said the purchase was part of a global Prudential strategy to expand through acquisitions.
Perry said it was too soon to comment on what the acquisition would mean in terms of the structure and staff numbers for an expanded Prudential.
Prudential NZ Ltd recently announced its investment arm, Prudential Portfolio Managers, was transferring its functions to Sydney. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
